decided: When a project signs off at every change's archive and the reader finds the AI's account of a change unclear, the account is rewritten to fix that wording before the user signs, one rewrite for each problem found, even when the same review sends work back to be redone.
alternatives: leave the unclear wording for the user to meet at sign-off
why: The reader takes the account so that the user signs over plain words a clean reader has checked; leaving its problems for the user would undo that.
